translations.web: then he shall be shaved, but he shall not shave the itch. Then the priest shall isolate the one who has the itch seven more days.
translations.bsb: then the person must shave himself except for the scaly area. Then the priest shall isolate him for another seven days.
translations.kjv: He shall be shaven, but the scall shall he not shave; and the priest shall shut up him that hath the scall seven days more:
translations.asv: then he shall be shaven, but the scall shall he not shave; and the priest shall shut up him that hath the scall seven days more:
